summary: Installation, taps and source-connector registration are well specified, but sink registration, plugin-level methods and removal are undefined; the biggest gap is what PackageIdentity is computed from, which governs evidence invalidation.

questions.text: What is PackageIdentity (the evidence producer identity) computed from, and does instance configuration form part of it?
questions.reason: Decides when stored evidence and sync positions become incompatible and must be refetched; 0014 says evidence is 'bound to producing plugin source and payload contract' and a changed Files config 'starts a new producer', but no ADR defines the computation.

questions.text: What shape does the host-derived plugin-package comparison take, and where is it persisted in the candidate and accepted archive?
questions.reason: Changes the persisted candidate.dhall/result.dhall encoding; 0015 requires saving it 'with the candidate and accepted report', but 0010's EvolutionReport holds only kind and step reports.

questions.text: How does a package declare source dependencies, and where are vendored dependencies stored so the compiler closure includes them?
questions.reason: Fixes the manifest fields, KB layout and origin records; 0015 says installation 'vendors plugin source and its source dependencies' yet 'the first packages are self-contained' with dependency acquisition a later slice.

questions.text: How are fixed plugin functions (description, health) and methods not attached to a connector registered, typed and invoked?
questions.reason: The connectors registration has no field for them and no command invokes health; 0015 only says they 'share one registration mechanism and generated adapter' (also 0008).

questions.text: How is a plugin removed through an evolution, and what happens to its orphaned config file?
questions.reason: No removal verb exists (0018 lists only install); 0015 says 'removals follow this same evolution-owned route' without defining the operation.

questions.text: What fields does a SinkConnector registration have, and does a sink type expose one publish entry or several named methods?
questions.reason: Plugin authors write this record and inspection/dispatch depend on it; 0015 shows only SourceConnector and 0017 says 'private registration representation is omitted' while SinkReference names a method.

questions.text: What are the constructors of the SDK FetchError type and how does each render as a diagnostic?
questions.reason: Every connector, captured method and tool returns it; 0014 requires truncation to be 'distinct in its diagnostic from a missing ID or corrupt/missing blob', but no ADR defines the type.

questions.text: Does plugin install into a Ready evolution mark it Draft?
questions.reason: 0010 says 'authoring operations that change evaluation inputs mark the workspace Draft'; 0015 only says Ready targets 'remain editable' and the candidate goes stale.

questions.text: Does reinstalling a package overwrite local edits to the vendored source, or detect and refuse them?
questions.reason: Risk of silently discarding reviewed local edits; 0015 says reinstall replaces the package 'with no force flag' yet verification requires 'refuse destructive replacement of local source edits'.

questions.text: What validation applies to tap names and catalogue entries, and must a tap entry's name match the package manifest name?
questions.reason: Tap names become .kyyn/taps/<name>/ paths and qualified selectors; 0015 gives no name rule or mismatch behaviour.
